generic_lessons: Load ACK, original Continue and actual in-game readback are separate observations; loading-only endpoints can refuse or time out before the real game context exists. Do not replay a successful Load or Continue to resolve an endpoint diagnostic.
Cold completed-state equality is a narrow positive result. It does not repair an interrupted ARMED case, establish bootstrap zero actions, or prove the next building was started.
An existing unit production screenshot must be captioned as preservation evidence, even when the code change concerns a future building.

Formal menu navigation may activate a client and remains an input. Use a separate current-instance background read-only mode proof immediately before game spawn; navigation ACK is not proof and offline mode is not remote-account idleness.
